chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: His sister Anna, Eddie Garland and Johnny Garland's band
summary: Dawson's sister Anna did not play but liked musicians; Eddie Garland was her boyfriend, and played in his brother Johnny Garland's six-piece uptown band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
